The first guest lectures that students attend will be part of the Symposium on Ethics and Sustainability. Over the course of their studies, each student will attend twelve guest lectures in total and write reflections on them.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates broaden their knowledge horizon through new perspectives, thereby integrating the thematic breadth of the MMA studies into their work. They develop new artistic and technological, practical approaches and reflect on the knowledge gained from the guest lectures, summarizing it in written form.

courses.title: Master Exam
courses.content: Individual, intensive and autonomous disputation of the knowledge and skills acquired during the degree program, e.g. the ability to critically reflect on one's own Master Thesis and specialization and present one's own findings in theory and work for discussion. Reflection on the problems within the Master's thesis.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates demonstrate with the master’s thesis and the examination their ability to research and prepare a complex topic in a scientifically sound manner, present it in a well-argued text, support the proposed hypotheses with a wide range of source material, and discuss these in the context of the defense. Furthermore, they establish connections to the main focuses of the master’s program and provide outlooks, for example, in research and application.

courses.title: Master Project Presentation
courses.content: Presentation of Master's Project
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to defend and present their project in front of colleagues and supervisors. They can also make their work accessible to the public.

courses.title: Master Thesis
courses.content: Individual, intensive and autonomous application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the degree programme, e.g. the ability to subject one's own Master's thesis to critical reflection and to present one's own findings in theory and work for discussion. In-depth, multifaceted disputation in individual supervision to support the Master's thesis in terms of both the work and the theoretical explanations. Comprehensive, topic-specific and independent reflection on the problems within the Master's theses.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to research and prepare a complex topic in a scientifically sound manner. They can present the research subject in a well-argued text and support the proposed hypotheses with a wide range of source material.

courses.title: Transfer Project 2
courses.content: Professional field-specific knowledge and skills in collaboration, implementation, and publication of multimedia or interdisciplinary practical tasks within the framework of multiple projects, with autonomous use of complex methods and techniques for independent learning and problem-solving, adept self-organization, and exceptional competence in justifying and explaining the creative-artistic and interdisciplinary development and design process.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to collaborate on a Master's project outside of their own for a duration of 25 hours, gaining exposure to different project cultures and styles.

courses.title: Master Project - Release - AUDIOVISUAL ENVIRONMENTS
courses.content: Professional handling of methods, workflows and tools of audiovisual environments in the completion phase and in the context of release/publication. Professional knowledge and skills in the implementation and publication of innovative audiovisual environment projects with consideration of contemporary distribution forms and channels (including distribution strategies of (pop) culture in the digital, globalized society, effects of YouTube, Facebook on various platforms in a high-quality and adequate form. Consideration of current developments in the areas of performance, communication and preservation of audiovisual culture, adaptation strategies of the entertainment industry. Professional defense of the project (theoretical foundation, reflection, evalua-tion, argumentation, etc.) in connection with the Master's thesis. Autonomous finishing of the audiovisual environment realization using state-of-the-art technology: tests, publication, accompanying communication measures, perfor-mance/publication (including submission to competitions and festivals).
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to independently carry out projects in an interdisciplinary team and present them appropriately to a larger professional audience. They present the resulting work in an environment that aligns with the nature and intention of the project, ensuring that its core message and objectives are clearly communicated to a broad professional audience.

courses.title: Master Project - Release - COMMUNICATION DESIGN
courses.module: Compulsory Elective 1 - Release & Presentation - Communication Design
courses.content: Subject-specific issues relating to communication design are discussed as the students' projects progress. The focus is on questions regarding the realization of design projects, the role of designers in project teams and the further sharpening of the communication strategy.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to carry out projects independently in an interdisciplinary team and present them in an appropriate form to a larger specialist audience. They present the resulting work in an environment that corresponds to the nature and intention of the work, ensuring that its core message and objective are clear to a broader specialized audience.

courses.title: Master Project - Release - FILM
courses.content: Professional mastery of methods and tools for the completion and distribution of Future Cinema projects, including publication on various platforms, with consideration of current distribution channels. Expertise in the high-quality realization and presentation of innovative works, accompanied by a well-founded theoretical defense. Interdisciplinary team competence for the independent execution and completion of projects, as well as the autonomous finalization of Future Cinema projects to current technical standards, including the development of marketing materials and communication strategies for publication and participation in competitions and festivals.
courses.learningOutcome: Graduates are able to independently carry out projects in an interdisciplinary team and present them in an appropriate form to a larger professional audience. They present the resulting work in an environment that aligns with the nature and intention of the work, ensuring that its core message and objectives are clearly communicated to a broad professional audience.
